name: Smallpox eradication declared
short_desc: The World Health Assembly declares smallpox eradicated after a coordinated international vaccination and surveillance campaign.
date_note: The World Health Assembly declared eradication on 8 May 1980. The last naturally occurring case was recorded in 1977; certification followed in 1979.
notes: Added after a catalog gap review on 24 October 2026. A major global public-health achievement, distinct from the existing 1796 vaccination experiment. Evidence and date rationale: The World Health Assembly declaration was adopted on 8 May 1980. The last naturally occurring case was recorded in 1977 and the certification commission reported in 1979; this point marks the formal declaration, not the date of the last infection. Primary evidence: https://www.who.int/news-room/detail/08-05-2020-commemorating-smallpox-eradication-a-legacy-of-hope-for-covid-19-and-other-diseases. Cached Wikipedia introduction and lead image provide separately attributed background. Remains review, not comprehensive factual approval.
